newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Rugby League-Lions refuse to name arrested player.
newsitem.headline: Rugby League-Lions refuse to name arrested player.

text.p: PALMERSTON NORTH, Oct 30 - Junior Lions' rugby league manager Jim Hartley on Wednesday refused to name the Great Britain under-19 player arrested for fighting outside a Palmerston North nightspot last Saturday morning after the second test.
NZPA reports that Leeds prop Nick Fozzard, 19, was named on a police arrest sheet as being detained at 2.40 a.m. outside the nightclub but the birthdate listed is not his.
However, Hartley hotly denied Fozzard had been arrested at all.

The man who was arrested gave his name as Nickolas Fozzard and told police his birthdate was December 12, 1976. But official statistics supplied by the British Rugby League show Fozzard's birthdate as July 22, 1977.

Senior Great Britain manager Phil Lowe confirmed today Fozzard had been sent home but said it was only because Fozzard had a shoulder injury which would prevent him playing any of the remaining matches.
